title: 归档当前打开的会话：应离开活跃列表并回退
description: 先打开一个会话，再从它自己的行菜单归档。归档成功后该行应离开活跃列表，主区域应回退到另一个会话或新对话页，不能停留在被归档内容上。
expectations: 侧边栏不再有该会话行
主区域不再显示被归档会话的内容

db.sql: SELECT title FROM (SELECT title FROM threads WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status != 'deleted' AND archived_at IS NULL AND pinned = 0 AND title NOT IN (SELECT name FROM workspaces) ORDER BY COALESCE(last_message_at, updated_at) DESC LIMIT 8) WHERE length(title) <= 16 LIMIT 1
SELECT archived_at IS NOT NULL AS ok FROM threads WHERE title = '{{target}}' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

assert.message: 归档后侧边栏不再有该会话行
主区域不再显示被归档会话的内容
